inline.headline: One list. Then the beach.
inline.text: Snap each room and the yard in Jib and it builds your lock-up list for the weekend before you leave, so nothing is left for the driveway.
inline.alt: A single-storey red brick house at dusk with a table lamp glowing behind sheer curtains in the front window and the rest of the house dark

jobs.title: Put the lounge lamp on a timer
jobs.description: On at dusk, off at 11. From the street it looks like someone's home.
directions: Plug the timer into the power point by the lamp
Set its clock to the right time
Push in the pins for 7 pm to 11 pm
Plug the lamp in and leave its switch on

jobs.title: Trim the hedge under the front window
Ask next door to clear the letterbox

end.headline: Lock up, then switch off.
end.alt: A solar motion sensor light switched on above a timber side gate on a red brick house at dusk, lighting the concrete path

jobs.title: Fit a motion sensor light over the side gate
jobs.description: A solar one screws to the wall, so there's no wiring and no electrician.
directions: Pick a spot where the panel gets some sun
Drill the brick with a masonry bit and fit the plugs
Screw the light to the wall
Walk past at dusk to check it comes on

jobs.title: Turn the washing machine taps off
Clear the fridge of milk and leftovers

inline.headline: Back on, with the wait built in.
inline.text: Snap your hot water system in Jib and it saves the switch-off steps for the day you leave and a 'back on' job for the day you return.
inline.alt: A finger switching off one circuit breaker on the switchboard inside an open meter box on a brick wall

jobs.title: Turn the hot water off at the switchboard
jobs.description: Only the switch marked hot water or HWS. Everything else stays on.
directions: Find the switch marked hot water or HWS
Add a 'back on' job for the day you get home

jobs.title: Check the tank for leaks before you go
Turn the washing machine taps off

end.headline: Home, hot, and safe to use.
end.alt: A white electric storage hot water tank on a concrete slab against a red brick wall in the late afternoon

jobs.title: Hot water back on, then wait
jobs.description: Give it several hours, or overnight, so it's back above 60°C before the first shower.
directions: Flick the hot water switch back on
Leave the hot taps off for several hours, or overnight
Once it's hot, run each hot tap for a minute
No hot water after a day? Call a licensed plumber
